About Me

Hi, I’m Adam Troxell. I’m a full-stack engineer and former CTO with a strong track record of building and shipping production systems end to end. I specialize in turning ambiguous ideas into reliable, scalable software, from backend APIs and databases to dashboards, infrastructure, and deployment.

Most recently, I served as the sole engineer and CTO at RJ Energy Solutions, where I designed, built, and deployed the company’s entire technical platform. This included real-time sensor data ingestion, backend APIs, database architecture, alerting and monitoring systems, and a customer-facing dashboard used in live pilot environments. I owned the full lifecycle of the product, from architecture and implementation to deployment, iteration, and support, working closely with leadership and customers to deliver practical, business-driven solutions.

Before RJES, I completed an intensive full-stack program at Emerging Digital Academy, strengthening my foundation in modern web development with React, Node.js, and testing frameworks like Cypress. I also bring years of experience from technical support, solutions management, and customer-facing roles, which shaped my ability to design software that is not just functional, but intuitive, resilient, and aligned with real user needs.

Although I’ve held leadership titles, my work has always been deeply hands-on. I enjoy building systems, writing clean and maintainable code, and taking ownership of complex problems until they are solved. I’m especially effective in small teams and fast-moving environments where autonomy, technical judgment, and accountability matter.

Outside of work, I enjoy traveling with my wife, cruising, and visiting theme parks. I value curiosity, inclusivity, and continuous learning, and I’m always looking for opportunities to build meaningful software that has real-world impact.

WanderWise

WanderWise is a comprehensive travel planning application designed to streamline the process of organizing trips. It offers features such as detailed trip itineraries, dynamic packing lists, and map locations, ensuring that users have all their travel information in one place. Built with React, Redux, Express, and PostgreSQL, WanderWise showcases my ability to integrate multiple technologies to create a user-friendly and efficient solution for travel planning. Whether you're preparing for a short getaway or a long journey, WanderWise helps you stay organized and ready for your adventure.

View the project

Energy Audit Portal

A proof-of-concept web application designed to replace RJ Energy Solutions' Google Sheets workflow for tracking equipment, costs, and carbon footprint. The portal allows auditors and employees to input data on facility equipment and provides recommendations to increase energy efficiency and reduce CO2 expenditure. Built with React.js, Express.js, Node.js, Redux, Passport.js, and Material UI, the app features a user-friendly interface for managing facility information, conducting energy audits, and reviewing completed audits.
